strings.en: Trombe, now is the time to ride!
I'll ask you to make way.
Let your neigh thunder across the battlefield, Trombe!
I won't misjudge the moment to strike!
As befits a whirlwind,/　I shall send this dragon to the heavens!
Crystal Dragoon.../　I shall shatter those wings!
Trombe! Time to show the power of a dragon steed!
Lay your bones to rest in this world, Skull Knight!
Skull Knight... You and I don't see eye to eye.
I know not whose old bones you are, but...!
Rushing for glory will bring about your ruin.
The final curtain is near, Jua-Mu Dalubi!
Against the attacks of one who fights only for desire!
Al-Van... I'll face you with the Trombe!
Shall we cross swords, Al-Van Ranks?
I shall see through that sword.
You'd become a disloyal vassal/　and turn your blade on your lord?!
Trombe, let us blow a hole through their lines!
Neither of us has a way back, Karo-Ran!
A cause tainted by ambition ends here!
Gu-Landon Gortz.../　I shall usher you into darkness!
Even if you hide your killing intent...!
Clear the way to the Rabulpaila!
That scythe cannot cut through a tornado!
I'm forcing my way through, Vort Nikolaus!
A tornado shall scatter the Whirlwind of Blood!
Even knowing the calamity the Cross Gate brings,/　you still seek to use its power...!
Herluga... You don't seem to realize/　you stand at the very edge of hell's gate.
Hideous pharaoh, kindly return to the underworld!
Clown from another world, I shall face you!
I shall put a stop to that wicked laughter.
If the machine is unmanned, I shan't hold back.
XN-L,/　do not think you can deny the path we have walked!
As a black tornado, I shall sink this deity ship!
Beyond the eyes of the Zovorg Privy Council...!
Abhorrent visitors, leave the Earth Sphere.
I cannot allow the Golaikunru to run rampant.
Golaikunru, you will leave the Earth Sphere!
Whatever these war merchants may be plotting...!
I can't afford to lose a valuable source of information.
A Zeidram, hm? I mustn't misjudge the distance.
I already have the Org-Valu's data.
I shall slip through this rain of fire!
Is that really a new Zovorg model?
Allow me to test the new model's performance.
Fury, learn the true extent of our power!
Trombe, let us scatter the Fury's vanguard!
I can't give the Raftclans/　any time...!
I must break through here at all costs...!
A Cupid cannot stop the Trombe!
I won't let the Lamaris have their way!
I'll take on that Lamaris Kaana!
I shall destroy these swarming vengeful spirits!
I can't leave the Lamaris Ida alone!
Its charging power is not to be underestimated...!
Ares Geist... What did you return seeking?
If that is the result of endlessly defying fate...!
I won't let you become the vessel of dark wisdom!
Trombe, let us scatter the Demons!
You stand in my way, Demon?
Let me repay you in kind!
Trombe, the real fight begins now!
Do you have what it takes/　to stop my Trombe...?
I'll have to ask you not to get cocky!
Show me the resolve with which you stand before me!
Allow me to show you my hand as well.
Ngh...!/　To think Trombe would be downed...!
Interesting...!/　To think you'd push me this far.
Gah...!/　This is not where I am meant to die...!
Heh... I can't join my wife/　in the beyond just yet.
Before he invites further calamity,/　I must defeat Herluga...!
To unleash such power in his own home...!
I can't let XN-L leave this sector!
Well done./　But you lack the power to down my Trombe.
Ngh...!/　To misjudge my opponent's strength.../　I am still inexperienced, it seems.
It seems/　I must get serious as well.
Heh... Neither of us can turn back now.
So-Des, this won't make me flinch.
Fu-Ruu... To think you'd surpass my reading.
I won't give my life to the black Grim Reaper.
I played right into Iradoya's hands...!
Gomoudokka... You have the skill/　to stand on the front lines yourself, it seems.
Vort, I'll grant that was splendid.
Reggiane, I won't let you go any further.
The Cross Gate is beyond human control...!
I must see through his illusions...!
You hold back a tornado, Crystal Dragoon...!
Humans are not as weak as you think!
Come to stake it all, Raftclans?!
What is it? No need to hold back.
Landing a hit on my Trombe/　is commendable, but...
Don't think momentum alone can defeat me.
Damage at this level/　won't hinder combat.
You're not stepping in far enough, Jua-Mu.
A sharp blow, but it lacks my friend's weight.
Karo-Ran, feints won't work on me!
That's not enough to stop me, Gu-Landon!
Vort, that's not enough to stop me.
I must stop Herluga as soon as possible...!
Was I deceived by his arts?
Crystal Dragoon, is that the extent of your power?
Horse and rider as one... No, horse and bones.
XN-L... Allow me to assess your power.
Even if I must use myself as bait,/　I'll draw the enemy in.
Is that all the Raftclans' power amounts to?
Unable to shake off the Lamaris... A blunder.
I can't afford to struggle with a Kaana type.
So it's not only its appearance that's changed.
Oh? You've set your sights/　on me and my Trombe?
No need to even read it...
Those moves... An instant/　is all I need to read them!
My Trombe won't fall/　to an attack like that!
You simply picked the wrong opponent, Jua-Mu.
I've long watched a swordsman's moves up close.
You won't read my movements, Karo-Ran!
Is that all the Emperor's unit can do?
For all your attitude, that blow held no hesitation.
Sizing people up in battle is hardly good taste.
You cannot stain the Trombe with blood.
I've no intention of joining a clown's games.
Dragon or not, it can't stop a tornado!
Not even those wings/　can catch the Trombe.
I'm used to fighting this foe.
Even with a Commander unit's performance,/　you can't catch my Trombe!
Even a Raftclans can't catch me.
Your blade won't reach the Trombe.
I must hurry and annihilate the Lamaris.
Even with wings, you can't catch my Trombe.
With skills like that,/　you'll never catch my Trombe.
I'll thank you not to underestimate me.
Take my advice./　Come back when you're ready.
You're failing to make/　full use of your power.
You simply picked the wrong opponent.
I knew how this would end.
Are those wings just for show?
The Trombe will not be slain by mere spirits.
Allow me to express my thanks.
Attacking from beyond my range.../　You know the fundamentals of battle.
Don't think that was the end of it!
That carelessness will cost you your life!
Permit me to add an attack of my own!
Rai, leave the rest to me.
Rai, I shall lend you my strength.
I'm right behind you, my friend!
Gilliam... I shall lend you my strength.
Gilliam, leave the rest to me.
Carla, I shall lend you a hand.
Heh, to think Carla would/　stick me with the cleanup.
Yuuki, let us coordinate our attack.
Raul, leave the rest to me.
Kota, kindly make way for me.
Josh, leave the rest to me.
Allow me to join you, Rim.
Arieil, leave the rest to me.
Ing, I shall lend you my strength.
Leave the rest to me, Touya.
Akimi, I'll take it from here.
Haken, let me lend a hand.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Leave this to me and regroup!
My friend, leave this to me!
My friend, I'll take on that enemy!
I won't let you lay a hand on the Kurogane!
Don't let your guard down, Carla!
In that formation, I need no one else!
Bunching together like that/　was your undoing!
My sights remain fixed on you!
Trombe, pierce all that stands in our way!
Allow me to end this now!
My sights shall guide you to your fate...!
Curse your misfortune in meeting me...!
None shall stand in my way...!
Trombe, become a tornado, true to your name!
My friend, now we show them our power!
My friend, now is the time to charge!
Roar, Dygenguar!/　Like a god of war!!
Run, Trombe! True to your name!
Take it! My Trombe's mightiest blow!!
I'll have you take every round!!
Quality ingredients are also/　the mark of a fine dish...!
Life or death. Choose whichever you like.
Life or death... Choose whichever you like!
So that tragedy never happens again...
Behold the power of the strongest/　shield, reborn!
Life or death. Choose whichever you like!
Tear the enemy apart like a tornado!
A primitive weapon, but powerful enough!
Tear my enemy apart!/　Leap Slasher!
Curse your misfortune in meeting me!
Charge forth, like a swift steed!
Life or death. Choose whichever you like...!
None shall stand in my way.
With the sword of the ill star,/　I'll strike you down!
Go ahead and curse your misfortune.
I'll have you take every round!
Trombe, lead my foe to ill fortune...!
Curse your misfortune in meeting me.
I'll have you take my MTD missiles!
Don't underestimate the agility/　of these Missiles!
Kindly accept this light from the heavens!
I'll press the attack like a tornado!
This won't end with just my fists!
I shall use Type Haken's trump card!
This time, I shall be the Trombe myself.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Boost Knuckle, strike down my foe!
With the blade of the evil star, I cut down my foe!
So you've been lured down the road to the underworld.
Savor the finesse of the bayonet!
There's no way to stop the storm!
You can't keep up with these moves!
I'll give you no chance to escape!
A blow with everything I've got!
Be struck by a rain of light!
